topic.name: 军事、安全与突发事件
topic.description: 追踪冲突、军备、公共安全和仍在发展的重大事件

overview: 今日专题“军事、安全与突发事件”。共筛选 23 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

featured.title: Stop undermining Jim Chalmers, environment minister urges Labor colleagues
featured.summary: ‘It’s pretty obvious that there are all sorts of people making all sorts of comments,’ Murray Watt says after budget savings meeting Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast The environment minister, Murray Watt, has urged ministers to stop undermining the treasurer, Jim Chalmers, as Labor struggles to sell its budget and looks to cut popular clean energy subsidies to help with the fight against inflation. Cabinet ministers met again on Monday to discuss potential budget savings to be included in next month’s mid-year update, part of efforts to reducing spending to ease pressure on the economy. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
featured.titleZh: 环境部长敦促工党同僚停止削弱吉姆·查尔默斯的权威
featured.summaryZh: 环境部长穆雷·瓦特呼吁内阁成员停止削弱财政部长查尔默斯的权威，目前工党正面临预算销售困难及削减清洁能源补贴以应对通胀的压力。内阁部长们正讨论年中预算更新的潜在削减方案，旨在通过减少支出缓解经济压力。
featured.whyImportant: 此举反映了澳大利亚工党政府在应对经济挑战和预算压力时内部存在的政治分歧。

featured.title: ‘I never executed Jesse Baird’: Beau Lamarre-Condon re-enacts shooting when giving evidence in NSW trial
featured.summary: Former police officer has pleaded not guilty to murdering Baird and Luke Davies in Paddington in early 2024 Warning: This article contains graphic content Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Beau Lamarre-Condon has denied he was “homicidal”, not “suicidal”, as prosecutors in his double murder trial alleged he used claims of workplace bullying for sympathy. The former police officer is accused of fatally shooting Baird and his new partner, Luke Davies, with his police service weapon in Baird’s Paddington home in Sydney on 19 February 2024. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
featured.titleZh: “我从未处决杰西·贝尔德”：博·拉马尔-康登在新南威尔士州审判中重演枪击过程
featured.summaryZh: 前警官博·拉马尔-康登在双重谋杀案审判中否认自己有杀人动机，并反驳了检方关于其利用职场霸凌指控博取同情的说法。他被控于2024年2月在悉尼家中用警用武器枪杀了杰西·贝尔德及其伴侣卢克·戴维斯。
featured.whyImportant: 该案件因涉及前警官使用公职武器杀人而引发了公众对警察暴力及司法公正的广泛关注。

featured.title: Fixing UK’s youth jobs crisis demands much more investment, TUC boss warns
featured.summary: Paul Nowak also calls on government to avoid arbitrary benefit cuts before much-anticipated Milburn report is published this week Fixing Britain’s youth jobs crisis will require ministers to drastically increase investment in employment support while avoiding arbitrary cuts to benefits, the head of the trade union movement has said. Before an important official report expected next week, the general secretary of the Trades Union Congress, Paul Nowak, said the government had a “once in a generation chance” to secure young people’s futures. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
featured.titleZh: 工会大会主席警告：解决英国青年就业危机需要更多投资
featured.summaryZh: 英国工会大会秘书长保罗·诺瓦克表示，政府应大幅增加就业支持投资，并避免随意削减福利。他认为在即将发布的米尔本报告前，政府拥有改善年轻人未来的关键机会。
featured.whyImportant: 该言论强调了在经济转型期，政府在社会保障与就业支持政策平衡上的重要性。

featured.title: Child abuse cases rise in Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore. Why?
featured.summary: Malaysia, Indonesia and Singapore have all recorded rising numbers of child abuse cases in recent years, but child welfare advocates say this may be a sign of progress rather than worsening violence, as greater awareness and improved reporting bring more cases to the attention of authorities. “The good news is that more people are reporting,” said Hartini Zainuddin, a veteran advocate for abused children in Malaysia. Official figures show growing caseloads in all three countries, but differences...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
featured.titleZh: 马来西亚、印度尼西亚和新加坡的虐童案件呈上升趋势，原因何在？
featured.summaryZh: 马来西亚、印度尼西亚和新加坡近年记录的虐童案件数量有所增加。儿童福利倡导者认为，这反映了公众意识的提高和报告机制的改善，而非暴力行为的恶化。
featured.whyImportant: 案件数量的上升被视为社会对儿童保护重视程度提高的积极信号，有助于推动更完善的法律保障。

featured.title: AI pulls up the civil service ladder to Southeast Asia’s middle class
featured.summary: Artificial intelligence promises to make government bureaucracies leaner across Asia, but its biggest effect on public-sector employment may not come from the widely feared wave of lay-offs. Instead, analysts say the technology is more likely to reshape existing jobs and narrow opportunities for young graduates hoping to enter the civil service, even as governments seek to improve efficiency without sacrificing job security. Unlike the Netherlands, which aims to cut an estimated 25,000 full-time...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
featured.titleZh: 人工智能正在阻碍东南亚中产阶级的公务员职业晋升之路
featured.summaryZh: 分析人士指出，人工智能在政府部门的应用虽能提高效率，但可能重塑就业结构并减少年轻毕业生的公务员岗位机会。政府在追求行政精简的同时，正面临如何在不牺牲就业保障的前提下利用技术的挑战。
featured.whyImportant: 人工智能对公共部门就业的影响可能加剧东南亚地区年轻人的就业竞争压力。

featured.title: Teaching GCSE topics younger risks turning schools into ‘early exam factories’, Powell warns
featured.summary: Lucy Powell says proposals to end widespread practice will be included in overhaul of England’s national curriculum Pushing GCSE subjects on younger pupils risks turning England’s secondary schools into “early exam factories”, the education secretary has said, warning that it is increasing disengagement from education. Lucy Powell wants schools to end the widespread practice of teaching GCSE topics to pupils in year 9 or earlier, before they officially start in year 10, and says she plans to reduce the amount of GCSE content to make it easier to fit into the official timetable. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
featured.titleZh: 鲍威尔警告：过早教授GCSE课程可能使学校沦为“早期考试工厂”
featured.summaryZh: 英国教育大臣露西·鲍威尔计划在课程改革中禁止在九年级或更早阶段教授GCSE课程。她认为这种做法导致学生对教育产生抵触情绪，并计划精简GCSE内容以适应教学进度。
featured.whyImportant: 此项政策调整旨在减轻学生的学业压力，并改善英国中学教育的教学质量。

featured.title: Lisa Nandy wary of ‘circular arguments’ about rejoining EU
featured.summary: Culture secretary pushes back against talk of revisiting Brexit but says closer ties would fulfil referendum promises One of Andy Burnham’s cabinet ministers has said she wants to avoid “circular arguments” about whether the UK should rejoin the EU, underlining divisions at the top of government over revisiting Brexit. Lisa Nandy, the culture secretary, appeared to suggest she was not in favour of rejoining the trade bloc, but she said the prime minister should still pursue closer ties to fulfil the promises made at the time of the referendum. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
featured.titleZh: 丽莎·南迪对重返欧盟的“循环论证”持谨慎态度
featured.summaryZh: 文化大臣丽莎·南迪表示希望避免关于英国是否应重返欧盟的无休止争论，反映了政府高层对脱欧议题的分歧。她主张在不重返欧盟的前提下，通过建立更紧密的联系来履行脱欧公投时的承诺。
featured.whyImportant: 这表明英国政府在处理后脱欧时代的对欧关系时，试图在政治现实与选民期望之间寻找平衡。

featured.title: Gadi Eisenkot reaches out to Netanyahu allies as he strives to form government
featured.summary: Former military chief says prime minister brought Israel to historic crisis and it is approaching ‘point of no return’ Israel’s former military chief Gadi Eisenkot started the tough task of forming a government on Sunday, reaching out to Benjamin Netanyahu’s allies as he said the veteran prime minister had brought the country to a historic crisis. Eisenkot, 66, the leader of the Yashar party, who has vowed to bridge Israel’s deep polarisation under Netanyahu, formally received a mandate from the president, Isaac Herzog, who gave him 28 days to form a government despite his bloc lacking a clear majority. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
featured.titleZh: 加迪·艾森科特在组建政府的努力中接触内塔尼亚胡的盟友
featured.summaryZh: 以色列前军事首长加迪·艾森科特已获得组建政府的授权，并开始接触内塔尼亚胡的盟友。他批评内塔尼亚胡将国家带入历史性危机，并誓言要弥合以色列国内的严重极化现象。
featured.whyImportant: 艾森科特的组阁尝试标志着以色列政坛在长期动荡后寻求政治重组的关键时刻。

global.title: Polish prosecutors open terrorism investigation into Kraków shooting
global.summary: Six people killed in attack probably inspired by far right, according to officials, as police say suspect’s parents and sister found dead at his home Polish prosecutors have opened a terrorism investigation after a 24-year-old man opened fire in a busy market square in Kraków, killing six people including a Briton and injuring 17, in an attack that authorities said was probably inspired by far-right ideologies. Police confirmed on Sunday that three people found dead at the gunman’s home after the attack on Saturday afternoon were his father, 53, mother, 52, and sister, 21. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
global.titleZh: 波兰检察官对克拉科夫枪击案展开恐怖主义调查
global.summaryZh: 波兰克拉科夫市发生一起枪击事件，造成包括一名英国人在内的6人死亡，另有17人受伤。当局认为该袭击可能受极右翼意识形态驱动，且嫌疑人的父母及姐妹也被发现死于家中。
global.whyImportant: 此事件因涉及恐怖主义动机及家庭悲剧，引发了波兰国内对极右翼暴力威胁的广泛关注。

global.title: To be Asia’s events capital, Hong Kong must offer ticketing that works
global.summary: Hong Kong has set its sights on becoming Asia’s events capital. China’s five-year plans support the city’s role as an East-meets-West centre for international cultural exchange. The chief executive’s latest policy address commits the Tourism Board to strengthening Hong Kong’s reputation as the “events capital of Asia”. The economic benefits could be huge. International events bring tourists and business for hotels, restaurants, shops and transport operators. The South China Morning Post...
global.titleZh: 为成为亚洲盛事之都，香港必须提供有效的票务系统
global.summaryZh: 香港正致力于巩固其作为“亚洲盛事之都”的地位，以促进国际文化交流并带动旅游及相关经济发展。政策支持下，提升票务系统的效率与可靠性成为实现这一目标的关键环节。
global.whyImportant: 完善的票务基础设施是香港提升国际竞争力并吸引大型活动落户的核心保障。

china.title: Fire in northern China high-rise building kills 14, injures dozens more
china.summary: Fourteen people have been killed and dozens more hospitalised after a fire broke out in a high-rise building in northern China. The fire broke out at around 5pm on Sunday in Taiyuan, the capital city of Shanxi province, according to the local Yingze district government. The fire was put out by around 7pm and rescue efforts ended at around 8.30pm, the authorities’ statement said. That night, 38 people were sent to hospital, including five people who had died. By Monday morning, the death toll had...
china.titleZh: 中国北方一高层建筑发生火灾，造成14人死亡，数十人受伤
china.summaryZh: 山西省太原市一栋高层建筑于周日下午发生火灾，救援工作已于当晚结束。事故造成14人死亡，数十名伤者被送往医院接受救治。
china.whyImportant: 该起严重火灾事故再次引发了公众对于高层建筑消防安全及应急管理能力的讨论。

china.title: Man dies after being hit by bus in Hong Kong’s North Point
china.summary: A man in his 60s has died after being struck by a bus in Hong Kong’s North Point. The fatal accident happened at the junction of King’s Road and Tin Chong Street at around 8.17am, with police and ambulance personnel arriving at the scene after a report by the Citybus driver. Police said the victim suffered severe head injuries and was unconscious before being rushed to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital in Chai Wan, where he was certified dead at 8.54am. An investigation into the cause of...
china.titleZh: 香港北角一名男子被巴士撞倒后身亡
china.summaryZh: 香港北角英皇道与天仓街交界处发生一起致命交通意外，一名60多岁男子被巴士撞倒。伤者头部受重伤，送医后被证实不治身亡。
china.whyImportant: 此事故提醒公众在繁忙的城市交通环境中需高度注意道路安全。

china.title: Trump defends Nvidia CEO amid Chinese spying allegations
china.summary: Donald Trump has defended Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who admitted to an affair with a woman suspected of spying for China.
china.titleZh: 特朗普为陷入中国间谍指控的英伟达CEO辩护
china.summaryZh: 唐纳德·特朗普公开为英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋辩护，此前黄仁勋承认与一名涉嫌为中国从事间谍活动的女性有过婚外情。
china.whyImportant: 此事件涉及科技巨头高管与地缘政治敏感指控，引发了舆论对企业安全与个人行为的关注。

china.title: China digital bed bug map lets travellers flag hotels nationwide upon spotting pests
china.summary: A digital map of bed bug sightings has gained popularity in China but has also sparked controversy by allowing users to flag hotels where they claim to have found the insects with a single click. Since its launch on September 21, the app has attracted 200,000 users, who have marked more than 600 hotels across China. Any user can flag a hotel on the map after claiming to have spotted bed bugs there, and the marks are visible to all users. Some hotels have defended themselves, saying they were...
china.titleZh: 中国数字臭虫地图允许旅客一键标记全国酒店
china.summaryZh: 一款名为“臭虫地图”的应用程序在中国走红，允许用户一键标记发现臭虫的酒店。该应用自发布以来已吸引20万用户，标记了超过600家酒店，但也引发了部分酒店对真实性的质疑。
china.whyImportant: 该工具反映了消费者对住宿卫生问题的关注，同时也凸显了数字平台信息真实性与商业声誉之间的矛盾。

china.title: China’s comfortable brain-reading device achieves 94% mind-typing accuracy in day-long use
china.summary: Chinese researchers have created a comfortable electrode for non-invasive brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) that achieved over 94 per cent accuracy in visual mind-typing tests during day-long use. The gradient electrodes – designed to overcome the current trade-offs of conventional uniformly soft or rigid electrodes – were integrated into a commercial electroencephalogram (EEG) cap and tested during rest over the span of 14 hours. Furthermore, the electrodes enabled eight hours of stable EEG...
china.titleZh: 中国舒适型脑机接口设备实现94%的脑控打字准确率
china.summaryZh: 中国研究人员开发出一种新型非侵入式脑机接口电极，在长达14小时的测试中，视觉脑控打字准确率超过94%。该技术通过梯度电极设计，解决了传统电极在舒适度与信号稳定性之间的平衡问题。
china.whyImportant: 这项技术突破为脑机接口的商业化应用和长期佩戴提供了更具可行性的解决方案。

usa.title: Pope delivers veiled rebuke of Milei's austerity measures
usa.summary: Pontiff tells Argentina’s president the economy must benefit all on second stop of 12-day Latin America tour Pope Leo XIV has delivered a stinging critique of Argentine president Javier Milei’s harsh austerity measures, insisting growth must benefit all in a speech met with rapturous applause in Buenos Aires. “The economy must be at the service of the people, rather than people being at the service of the economy,” he said on Sunday, shortly after landing in Argentina on the second leg of a Latin America tour. Continue reading...
usa.titleZh: 教皇含蓄批评米莱的紧缩政策
usa.summaryZh: 教皇利奥十四世在阿根廷访问期间发表讲话，强调经济应服务于人民而非相反。此番言论被视为对阿根廷总统米莱推行的严厉紧缩政策的含蓄批评。
usa.whyImportant: 宗教领袖对国家经济政策的公开表态，反映了社会对当前经济改革带来的民生影响存在深刻分歧。

usa.title: Pope tells Argentina’s Milei leaders should know limits of power
usa.summary: Pope Leo on Sunday urged Argentina to safeguard its democracy in a closely watched speech to President Javier Milei, a close ally of US President Donald Trump, during the second stop of a 12-day South American tour by the Catholic leader. Leo told Milei, who has said he will seek re-election next year, that leaders must seek to better the lives of all their citizens and know the limits of their power. Milei’s austerity agenda has been criticised by the Church for hitting the poorest most, and...
usa.titleZh: 教皇告诉阿根廷总统米莱：领导人应知晓权力的界限
usa.summaryZh: 教皇在访问阿根廷期间向米莱总统发表讲话，敦促其维护民主并强调领导人应致力于改善公民生活。米莱的紧缩政策因对贫困人口影响较大而受到教会批评。
usa.whyImportant: 此举反映了宗教领袖对阿根廷政治走向及社会民生问题的关注与干预。

usa.title: The US must stop blaming China for problems at home: former envoy Cui Tiankai
usa.summary: The United States should not blame China’s rise for its own problems and should not expect that these can be solved by changing presidents, China’s longest-serving former ambassador to Washington has said. “China’s development has never aimed to replace or challenge the US – it never has. Naturally, I also hope the US can resolve its own issues and that its future development will not come at the expense of China’s interests,” Cui Tiankai, who served as ambassador to the US from 2013 to 2021,...
usa.titleZh: 前驻美大使崔天凯：美国必须停止将国内问题归咎于中国
usa.summaryZh: 中国前驻美大使崔天凯表示，美国不应将自身问题归咎于中国的发展，也不应寄希望于通过更换总统来解决问题。他强调中国的发展从未旨在挑战美国，并希望美国能妥善处理自身事务。
usa.whyImportant: 该言论重申了中方对中美关系的立场，呼吁美方以更理性的态度看待双边竞争。

usa.title: ‘Seismic shift’: Native American women made significant gains in US midterms
usa.summary: Nationwide, voters elected at least 75 Native women or non-binary candidates in Tuesday’s elections, report says The US midterm elections saw voters elect a slew of historic representatives – from the country’s first Muslim senator to the first Black female governor – but among the most significant gains were those for Native American women. On Tuesday, voters elected the first Native American woman governor, senator and leaders of two tribal nations. Nationwide, voters elected at least 75 Native women or non-binary and Two Spirit candidates in the November midterms, according to Advance Native Political Leadership and the news site ICT. Continue reading...
usa.titleZh: “地震级转变”：美国原住民女性在中期选举中取得重大进展
usa.summaryZh: 在近期美国中期选举中，全国范围内至少有75名原住民女性或非二元性别候选人当选。其中包括首位原住民女性州长和参议员，标志着原住民在政治代表性上的历史性突破。
usa.whyImportant: 这一选举结果体现了美国政治多元化进程的加速，以及少数群体政治参与度的显著提升。

usa.title: ICYMI: AG Todd Blanche Dismantles Democrats’ “Oversight” Charade on the Sunday Shows
usa.summary: This morning, Attorney General Todd Blanche appeared on the Sunday shows and made clear that the Department of Justice will fulfill its Constitutional duty to represent the Executive Branch — and that Democrats’ explicit threats of endless investigations, impeachments, and retribution against President Trump, Cabinet officials, and private citizens will not succeed. Key exchanges: The post ICYMI: AG Todd Blanche Dismantles Democrats’ “Oversight” Charade on the Sunday Shows appeared first on The White House.
usa.titleZh: 回顾：司法部长托德·布兰奇驳斥民主党的“监督”闹剧
usa.summaryZh: 司法部长托德·布兰奇在电视节目中表示，司法部将履行宪法职责代表行政部门。他强调，民主党针对特朗普总统及内阁官员的调查和弹劾威胁不会得逞。
usa.whyImportant: 此表态凸显了美国行政与立法部门之间围绕政治监督权力的激烈博弈。

watch.title: Jensen Huang: Silicon Valley superstar engulfed by personal scandal
watch.summary: Once lauded as the "Taylor Swift of tech", Huang is mired in scandal after an affair with a suspected Chinese spy.
watch.titleZh: 黄仁勋：硅谷巨星陷入个人丑闻
watch.summaryZh: 曾被誉为“科技界泰勒·斯威夫特”的黄仁勋，因被曝与一名疑似中国间谍的女子有染而陷入丑闻。这一事件对其个人声誉造成了严重影响。
watch.whyImportant: 作为科技行业领军人物，其个人丑闻可能引发公众对企业安全及高管行为准则的广泛讨论。

watch.title: Nvidia opens investigation after report CEO Jensen Huang was target of foreign intelligence
watch.summary: CEO reportedly ‌had close relationship ‌with a Chinese businesswoman who passed information to ‌Beijing Nvidia said ⁠on Sunday it “is initiating an independent investigation in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort”. watch.titleZh: 英伟达启动调查，此前有报道称CEO黄仁勋成为外国情报目标
watch.summaryZh: 英伟达宣布针对CEO黄仁勋成为外国情报目标一事展开独立调查。此前有报道称，黄仁勋曾与一名向北京传递信息的中国女商人关系密切。
watch.whyImportant: 该调查涉及国家安全与企业治理，可能对英伟达的业务运营及国际声誉产生深远影响。

watch.title: UK’s King Charles, Prince Harry honour war dead at separate Remembrance Day events
watch.summary: Prince Harry attended a Remembrance Sunday event in a small English town, far away from Britain’s main ceremony to honour the country’s war dead led by his father, King Charles. Ceremonies are held at war memorials across Britain on the Sunday closest to Armistice Day, November 11, which marks the peace agreement that ended World War I. The Sun and the Daily Mail tabloid newspapers posted photographs online of former British Army captain Harry, in a dark suit with military medals, chatting to...

watch.titleZh: 英国国王查尔斯与哈里王子分别参加阵亡将士纪念日活动
watch.summaryZh: 英国国王查尔斯与哈里王子在不同地点分别参加了阵亡将士纪念日活动。哈里王子在小镇出席仪式，而国王则主持了全国性的纪念活动。
watch.whyImportant: 王室成员在纪念活动中的分开出席，再次引发了外界对英国王室内部关系的关注。

items.title: Stop undermining Jim Chalmers, environment minister urges Labor colleagues
items.summary: ‘It’s pretty obvious that there are all sorts of people making all sorts of comments,’ Murray Watt says after budget savings meeting Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast The environment minister, Murray Watt, has urged ministers to stop undermining the treasurer, Jim Chalmers, as Labor struggles to sell its budget and looks to cut popular clean energy subsidies to help with the fight against inflation. items.titleZh: 环境部长敦促工党同僚停止削弱吉姆·查尔默斯的权威
items.summaryZh: 环境部长穆雷·瓦特呼吁内阁成员停止削弱财政部长查尔默斯的权威，目前工党正面临预算销售困难及削减清洁能源补贴以应对通胀的压力。内阁部长们正讨论年中预算更新的潜在削减方案，旨在通过减少支出缓解经济压力。
items.whyImportant: 此举反映了澳大利亚工党政府在应对经济挑战和预算压力时内部存在的政治分歧。

items.title: ‘I never executed Jesse Baird’: Beau Lamarre-Condon re-enacts shooting when giving evidence in NSW trial
items.summary: Former police officer has pleaded not guilty to murdering Baird and Luke Davies in Paddington in early 2024 Warning: This article contains graphic content Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Beau Lamarre-Condon has denied he was “homicidal”, not “suicidal”, as prosecutors in his double murder trial alleged he used claims of workplace bullying for sympathy. items.titleZh: “我从未处决杰西·贝尔德”：博·拉马尔-康登在新南威尔士州审判中重演枪击过程
items.summaryZh: 前警官博·拉马尔-康登在双重谋杀案审判中否认自己有杀人动机，并反驳了检方关于其利用职场霸凌指控博取同情的说法。他被控于2024年2月在悉尼家中用警用武器枪杀了杰西·贝尔德及其伴侣卢克·戴维斯。
items.whyImportant: 该案件因涉及前警官使用公职武器杀人而引发了公众对警察暴力及司法公正的广泛关注。

items.title: Fixing UK’s youth jobs crisis demands much more investment, TUC boss warns
items.summary: Paul Nowak also calls on government to avoid arbitrary benefit cuts before much-anticipated Milburn report is published this week Fixing Britain’s youth jobs crisis will require ministers to drastically increase investment in employment support while avoiding arbitrary cuts to benefits, the head of the trade union movement has said. Before an important official report expected next week, the general secretary of the Trades Union Congress, Paul Nowak, said the government had a “once in a generation chance” to secure young people’s futures. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 工会大会主席警告：解决英国青年就业危机需要更多投资
items.summaryZh: 英国工会大会秘书长保罗·诺瓦克表示，政府应大幅增加就业支持投资，并避免随意削减福利。他认为在即将发布的米尔本报告前，政府拥有改善年轻人未来的关键机会。
items.whyImportant: 该言论强调了在经济转型期，政府在社会保障与就业支持政策平衡上的重要性。

items.title: Child abuse cases rise in Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore. Why?
items.summary: Malaysia, Indonesia and Singapore have all recorded rising numbers of child abuse cases in recent years, but child welfare advocates say this may be a sign of progress rather than worsening violence, as greater awareness and improved reporting bring more cases to the attention of authorities. “The good news is that more people are reporting,” said Hartini Zainuddin, a veteran advocate for abused children in Malaysia. Official figures show growing caseloads in all three countries, but differences...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 马来西亚、印度尼西亚和新加坡的虐童案件呈上升趋势，原因何在？
items.summaryZh: 马来西亚、印度尼西亚和新加坡近年记录的虐童案件数量有所增加。儿童福利倡导者认为，这反映了公众意识的提高和报告机制的改善，而非暴力行为的恶化。
items.whyImportant: 案件数量的上升被视为社会对儿童保护重视程度提高的积极信号，有助于推动更完善的法律保障。

items.title: AI pulls up the civil service ladder to Southeast Asia’s middle class
items.summary: Artificial intelligence promises to make government bureaucracies leaner across Asia, but its biggest effect on public-sector employment may not come from the widely feared wave of lay-offs. Instead, analysts say the technology is more likely to reshape existing jobs and narrow opportunities for young graduates hoping to enter the civil service, even as governments seek to improve efficiency without sacrificing job security. Unlike the Netherlands, which aims to cut an estimated 25,000 full-time...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 人工智能正在阻碍东南亚中产阶级的公务员职业晋升之路
items.summaryZh: 分析人士指出，人工智能在政府部门的应用虽能提高效率，但可能重塑就业结构并减少年轻毕业生的公务员岗位机会。政府在追求行政精简的同时，正面临如何在不牺牲就业保障的前提下利用技术的挑战。
items.whyImportant: 人工智能对公共部门就业的影响可能加剧东南亚地区年轻人的就业竞争压力。

items.title: Teaching GCSE topics younger risks turning schools into ‘early exam factories’, Powell warns
items.summary: Lucy Powell says proposals to end widespread practice will be included in overhaul of England’s national curriculum Pushing GCSE subjects on younger pupils risks turning England’s secondary schools into “early exam factories”, the education secretary has said, warning that it is increasing disengagement from education. Lucy Powell wants schools to end the widespread practice of teaching GCSE topics to pupils in year 9 or earlier, before they officially start in year 10, and says she plans to reduce the amount of GCSE content to make it easier to fit into the official timetable. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 鲍威尔警告：过早教授GCSE课程可能使学校沦为“早期考试工厂”
items.summaryZh: 英国教育大臣露西·鲍威尔计划在课程改革中禁止在九年级或更早阶段教授GCSE课程。她认为这种做法导致学生对教育产生抵触情绪，并计划精简GCSE内容以适应教学进度。
items.whyImportant: 此项政策调整旨在减轻学生的学业压力，并改善英国中学教育的教学质量。

items.title: Lisa Nandy wary of ‘circular arguments’ about rejoining EU
items.summary: Culture secretary pushes back against talk of revisiting Brexit but says closer ties would fulfil referendum promises One of Andy Burnham’s cabinet ministers has said she wants to avoid “circular arguments” about whether the UK should rejoin the EU, underlining divisions at the top of government over revisiting Brexit. Lisa Nandy, the culture secretary, appeared to suggest she was not in favour of rejoining the trade bloc, but she said the prime minister should still pursue closer ties to fulfil the promises made at the time of the referendum. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 丽莎·南迪对重返欧盟的“循环论证”持谨慎态度
items.summaryZh: 文化大臣丽莎·南迪表示希望避免关于英国是否应重返欧盟的无休止争论，反映了政府高层对脱欧议题的分歧。她主张在不重返欧盟的前提下，通过建立更紧密的联系来履行脱欧公投时的承诺。
items.whyImportant: 这表明英国政府在处理后脱欧时代的对欧关系时，试图在政治现实与选民期望之间寻找平衡。

items.title: Gadi Eisenkot reaches out to Netanyahu allies as he strives to form government
items.summary: Former military chief says prime minister brought Israel to historic crisis and it is approaching ‘point of no return’ Israel’s former military chief Gadi Eisenkot started the tough task of forming a government on Sunday, reaching out to Benjamin Netanyahu’s allies as he said the veteran prime minister had brought the country to a historic crisis. Eisenkot, 66, the leader of the Yashar party, who has vowed to bridge Israel’s deep polarisation under Netanyahu, formally received a mandate from the president, Isaac Herzog, who gave him 28 days to form a government despite his bloc lacking a clear majority. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 加迪·艾森科特在组建政府的努力中接触内塔尼亚胡的盟友
items.summaryZh: 以色列前军事首长加迪·艾森科特已获得组建政府的授权，并开始接触内塔尼亚胡的盟友。他批评内塔尼亚胡将国家带入历史性危机，并誓言要弥合以色列国内的严重极化现象。
items.whyImportant: 艾森科特的组阁尝试标志着以色列政坛在长期动荡后寻求政治重组的关键时刻。

items.title: Polish prosecutors open terrorism investigation into Kraków shooting
items.summary: Six people killed in attack probably inspired by far right, according to officials, as police say suspect’s parents and sister found dead at his home Polish prosecutors have opened a terrorism investigation after a 24-year-old man opened fire in a busy market square in Kraków, killing six people including a Briton and injuring 17, in an attack that authorities said was probably inspired by far-right ideologies. Police confirmed on Sunday that three people found dead at the gunman’s home after the attack on Saturday afternoon were his father, 53, mother, 52, and sister, 21. Continue reading...
tags: 专题·军事、安全与突发事件
items.titleZh: 波兰检察官对克拉科夫枪击案展开恐怖主义调查
items.summaryZh: 波兰克拉科夫市发生一起枪击事件，造成包括一名英国人在内的6人死亡，另有17人受伤。当局认为该袭击可能受极右翼意识形态驱动，且嫌疑人的父母及姐妹也被发现死于家中。
items.whyImportant: 此事件因涉及恐怖主义动机及家庭悲剧，引发了波兰国内对极右翼暴力威胁的广泛关注。

items.title: To be Asia’s events capital, Hong Kong must offer ticketing that works
items.summary: Hong Kong has set its sights on becoming Asia’s events capital. China’s five-year plans support the city’s role as an East-meets-West centre for international cultural exchange. The chief executive’s latest policy address commits the Tourism Board to strengthening Hong Kong’s reputation as the “events capital of Asia”. The economic benefits could be huge. International events bring tourists and business for hotels, restaurants, shops and transport operators. The South China Morning Post...
items.titleZh: 为成为亚洲盛事之都，香港必须提供有效的票务系统
items.summaryZh: 香港正致力于巩固其作为“亚洲盛事之都”的地位，以促进国际文化交流并带动旅游及相关经济发展。政策支持下，提升票务系统的效率与可靠性成为实现这一目标的关键环节。
items.whyImportant: 完善的票务基础设施是香港提升国际竞争力并吸引大型活动落户的核心保障。

items.title: Fire in northern China high-rise building kills 14, injures dozens more
items.summary: Fourteen people have been killed and dozens more hospitalised after a fire broke out in a high-rise building in northern China. The fire broke out at around 5pm on Sunday in Taiyuan, the capital city of Shanxi province, according to the local Yingze district government. The fire was put out by around 7pm and rescue efforts ended at around 8.30pm, the authorities’ statement said. That night, 38 people were sent to hospital, including five people who had died. By Monday morning, the death toll had...
items.titleZh: 中国北方一高层建筑发生火灾，造成14人死亡，数十人受伤
items.summaryZh: 山西省太原市一栋高层建筑于周日下午发生火灾，救援工作已于当晚结束。事故造成14人死亡，数十名伤者被送往医院接受救治。
items.whyImportant: 该起严重火灾事故再次引发了公众对于高层建筑消防安全及应急管理能力的讨论。

items.title: Man dies after being hit by bus in Hong Kong’s North Point
items.summary: A man in his 60s has died after being struck by a bus in Hong Kong’s North Point. The fatal accident happened at the junction of King’s Road and Tin Chong Street at around 8.17am, with police and ambulance personnel arriving at the scene after a report by the Citybus driver. Police said the victim suffered severe head injuries and was unconscious before being rushed to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital in Chai Wan, where he was certified dead at 8.54am. An investigation into the cause of...
items.titleZh: 香港北角一名男子被巴士撞倒后身亡
items.summaryZh: 香港北角英皇道与天仓街交界处发生一起致命交通意外，一名60多岁男子被巴士撞倒。伤者头部受重伤，送医后被证实不治身亡。
items.whyImportant: 此事故提醒公众在繁忙的城市交通环境中需高度注意道路安全。

items.title: Trump defends Nvidia CEO amid Chinese spying allegations
items.summary: Donald Trump has defended Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who admitted to an affair with a woman suspected of spying for China.
items.titleZh: 特朗普为陷入中国间谍指控的英伟达CEO辩护
items.summaryZh: 唐纳德·特朗普公开为英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋辩护，此前黄仁勋承认与一名涉嫌为中国从事间谍活动的女性有过婚外情。
items.whyImportant: 此事件涉及科技巨头高管与地缘政治敏感指控，引发了舆论对企业安全与个人行为的关注。

items.title: China digital bed bug map lets travellers flag hotels nationwide upon spotting pests
items.summary: A digital map of bed bug sightings has gained popularity in China but has also sparked controversy by allowing users to flag hotels where they claim to have found the insects with a single click. Since its launch on September 21, the app has attracted 200,000 users, who have marked more than 600 hotels across China. Any user can flag a hotel on the map after claiming to have spotted bed bugs there, and the marks are visible to all users. Some hotels have defended themselves, saying they were...
items.titleZh: 中国数字臭虫地图允许旅客一键标记全国酒店
items.summaryZh: 一款名为“臭虫地图”的应用程序在中国走红，允许用户一键标记发现臭虫的酒店。该应用自发布以来已吸引20万用户，标记了超过600家酒店，但也引发了部分酒店对真实性的质疑。
items.whyImportant: 该工具反映了消费者对住宿卫生问题的关注，同时也凸显了数字平台信息真实性与商业声誉之间的矛盾。

items.title: China’s comfortable brain-reading device achieves 94% mind-typing accuracy in day-long use
items.summary: Chinese researchers have created a comfortable electrode for non-invasive brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) that achieved over 94 per cent accuracy in visual mind-typing tests during day-long use. The gradient electrodes – designed to overcome the current trade-offs of conventional uniformly soft or rigid electrodes – were integrated into a commercial electroencephalogram (EEG) cap and tested during rest over the span of 14 hours. Furthermore, the electrodes enabled eight hours of stable EEG...
items.titleZh: 中国舒适型脑机接口设备实现94%的脑控打字准确率
items.summaryZh: 中国研究人员开发出一种新型非侵入式脑机接口电极，在长达14小时的测试中，视觉脑控打字准确率超过94%。该技术通过梯度电极设计，解决了传统电极在舒适度与信号稳定性之间的平衡问题。
items.whyImportant: 这项技术突破为脑机接口的商业化应用和长期佩戴提供了更具可行性的解决方案。

items.title: Pope delivers veiled rebuke of Milei's austerity measures
items.summary: Pontiff tells Argentina’s president the economy must benefit all on second stop of 12-day Latin America tour Pope Leo XIV has delivered a stinging critique of Argentine president Javier Milei’s harsh austerity measures, insisting growth must benefit all in a speech met with rapturous applause in Buenos Aires. “The economy must be at the service of the people, rather than people being at the service of the economy,” he said on Sunday, shortly after landing in Argentina on the second leg of a Latin America tour. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 教皇含蓄批评米莱的紧缩政策
items.summaryZh: 教皇利奥十四世在阿根廷访问期间发表讲话，强调经济应服务于人民而非相反。此番言论被视为对阿根廷总统米莱推行的严厉紧缩政策的含蓄批评。
items.whyImportant: 宗教领袖对国家经济政策的公开表态，反映了社会对当前经济改革带来的民生影响存在深刻分歧。

items.title: Pope tells Argentina’s Milei leaders should know limits of power
items.summary: Pope Leo on Sunday urged Argentina to safeguard its democracy in a closely watched speech to President Javier Milei, a close ally of US President Donald Trump, during the second stop of a 12-day South American tour by the Catholic leader. Leo told Milei, who has said he will seek re-election next year, that leaders must seek to better the lives of all their citizens and know the limits of their power. Milei’s austerity agenda has been criticised by the Church for hitting the poorest most, and...
items.titleZh: 教皇告诉阿根廷总统米莱：领导人应知晓权力的界限
items.summaryZh: 教皇在访问阿根廷期间向米莱总统发表讲话，敦促其维护民主并强调领导人应致力于改善公民生活。米莱的紧缩政策因对贫困人口影响较大而受到教会批评。
items.whyImportant: 此举反映了宗教领袖对阿根廷政治走向及社会民生问题的关注与干预。

items.title: The US must stop blaming China for problems at home: former envoy Cui Tiankai
items.summary: The United States should not blame China’s rise for its own problems and should not expect that these can be solved by changing presidents, China’s longest-serving former ambassador to Washington has said. “China’s development has never aimed to replace or challenge the US – it never has. Naturally, I also hope the US can resolve its own issues and that its future development will not come at the expense of China’s interests,” Cui Tiankai, who served as ambassador to the US from 2013 to 2021,...
items.titleZh: 前驻美大使崔天凯：美国必须停止将国内问题归咎于中国
items.summaryZh: 中国前驻美大使崔天凯表示，美国不应将自身问题归咎于中国的发展，也不应寄希望于通过更换总统来解决问题。他强调中国的发展从未旨在挑战美国，并希望美国能妥善处理自身事务。
items.whyImportant: 该言论重申了中方对中美关系的立场，呼吁美方以更理性的态度看待双边竞争。

items.title: ‘Seismic shift’: Native American women made significant gains in US midterms
items.summary: Nationwide, voters elected at least 75 Native women or non-binary candidates in Tuesday’s elections, report says The US midterm elections saw voters elect a slew of historic representatives – from the country’s first Muslim senator to the first Black female governor – but among the most significant gains were those for Native American women. On Tuesday, voters elected the first Native American woman governor, senator and leaders of two tribal nations. Nationwide, voters elected at least 75 Native women or non-binary and Two Spirit candidates in the November midterms, according to Advance Native Political Leadership and the news site ICT. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: “地震级转变”：美国原住民女性在中期选举中取得重大进展
items.summaryZh: 在近期美国中期选举中，全国范围内至少有75名原住民女性或非二元性别候选人当选。其中包括首位原住民女性州长和参议员，标志着原住民在政治代表性上的历史性突破。
items.whyImportant: 这一选举结果体现了美国政治多元化进程的加速，以及少数群体政治参与度的显著提升。

items.title: ICYMI: AG Todd Blanche Dismantles Democrats’ “Oversight” Charade on the Sunday Shows
items.summary: This morning, Attorney General Todd Blanche appeared on the Sunday shows and made clear that the Department of Justice will fulfill its Constitutional duty to represent the Executive Branch — and that Democrats’ explicit threats of endless investigations, impeachments, and retribution against President Trump, Cabinet officials, and private citizens will not succeed. items.titleZh: 回顾：司法部长托德·布兰奇驳斥民主党的“监督”闹剧
items.summaryZh: 司法部长托德·布兰奇在电视节目中表示，司法部将履行宪法职责代表行政部门。他强调，民主党针对特朗普总统及内阁官员的调查和弹劾威胁不会得逞。
items.whyImportant: 此表态凸显了美国行政与立法部门之间围绕政治监督权力的激烈博弈。

items.title: Jensen Huang: Silicon Valley superstar engulfed by personal scandal
items.summary: Once lauded as the "Taylor Swift of tech", Huang is mired in scandal after an affair with a suspected Chinese spy.
items.titleZh: 黄仁勋：硅谷巨星陷入个人丑闻
items.summaryZh: 曾被誉为“科技界泰勒·斯威夫特”的黄仁勋，因被曝与一名疑似中国间谍的女子有染而陷入丑闻。这一事件对其个人声誉造成了严重影响。
items.whyImportant: 作为科技行业领军人物，其个人丑闻可能引发公众对企业安全及高管行为准则的广泛讨论。

items.title: Nvidia opens investigation after report CEO Jensen Huang was target of foreign intelligence
items.summary: CEO reportedly ‌had close relationship ‌with a Chinese businesswoman who passed information to ‌Beijing Nvidia said ⁠on Sunday it “is initiating an independent investigation in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort”. The New York Times reported in ​October that Donald Trump had been briefed last year on intelligence that Huang ‌had a close relationship ‌with a Chinese businesswoman who passed information to ‌Beijing. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 英伟达启动调查，此前有报道称CEO黄仁勋成为外国情报目标
items.summaryZh: 英伟达宣布针对CEO黄仁勋成为外国情报目标一事展开独立调查。此前有报道称，黄仁勋曾与一名向北京传递信息的中国女商人关系密切。
items.whyImportant: 该调查涉及国家安全与企业治理，可能对英伟达的业务运营及国际声誉产生深远影响。

items.title: UK’s King Charles, Prince Harry honour war dead at separate Remembrance Day events
items.summary: Prince Harry attended a Remembrance Sunday event in a small English town, far away from Britain’s main ceremony to honour the country’s war dead led by his father, King Charles. Ceremonies are held at war memorials across Britain on the Sunday closest to Armistice Day, November 11, which marks the peace agreement that ended World War I. The Sun and the Daily Mail tabloid newspapers posted photographs online of former British Army captain Harry, in a dark suit with military medals, chatting to...

items.titleZh: 英国国王查尔斯与哈里王子分别参加阵亡将士纪念日活动
items.summaryZh: 英国国王查尔斯与哈里王子在不同地点分别参加了阵亡将士纪念日活动。哈里王子在小镇出席仪式，而国王则主持了全国性的纪念活动。
items.whyImportant: 王室成员在纪念活动中的分开出席，再次引发了外界对英国王室内部关系的关注。
